name: Taffy Two Child Inline Storage

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: gpux vendored Taffy child storage with apps/test_suite wide DataTable headed WebGPU
hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

Replacing Taffy 0.12.2's `std` child alias from `Vec<NodeId>` to `SmallVec<[NodeId; 2]>` will avoid one heap allocation for 726 of the 782 non-leaf nodes rebuilt by the warmed DataTable frame (92.84%), improving allocation pressure and layout/render cadence while preserving child order, arbitrary fanout through overflow, all Taffy algorithms, and gpux APIs.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

1. Record repeated headed Test Suite checkpoint measurements at DPR 1 and 2 before editing.
2. Import the exact crates.io Taffy 0.12.2 package under `crates/gpux/vendor/taffy`, record its version/checksum provenance, and patch both root and nested workspaces to that path.
3. Change only the `std` `ChildrenVec<A>` alias to `SmallVec<[A; 2]>`, initialize leaf child storage with the same type, and add `smallvec` only to Taffy's `std` feature. Preserve alloc-only and heapless configurations.
4. Run the vendored Taffy library suite, focused gpux Taffy/scene tests, diagnostics-off/on checks, Clippy, nested/root formatting, and dependency-tree proof.
5. Run at least three fresh headed candidate processes at DPR 1 and 2. Compare per-process medians and p95 against the checkpoint distribution while requiring exact Taffy/renderer/tree/scroll counters.
6. Accept only if behavior is exact and central runtime measurements do not regress; otherwise revert the complete vendor import and dependency patch to the experiment checkpoint.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

The two-slot child representation removes 726 per-frame child-buffer heap allocations, leaves 56 overflowing containers, preserves all 1,123 nodes/1,041 edges and layout output, and improves or preserves repeated headed cadence enough to justify the approximately one-megabyte vendored dependency maintenance surface.

reportMarkdown:
# Taffy two-child inline storage report

RayX now uses the exact crates.io Taffy 0.12.2 package from `crates/gpux/vendor/taffy`, patched so standard-library `TaffyTree` child lists use `SmallVec<[NodeId; 2]>`. Larger child lists retain heap overflow, alloc-only and heapless modes are unchanged, and Taffy's public `children()` API still returns `Vec<NodeId>`.

The change removes child-buffer heap allocation from 726 of the 782 non-leaf nodes rebuilt by each warmed wide DataTable frame (92.84%). The remaining 56 containers spill normally, including the measured maximum fanout of 25.

Three independent headed WebGPU processes were measured on each side. At DPR 1, the median of process medians improved from 24.9036 to 29.8650 acknowledged steps/s (+19.92%) and paced p95 improved from 28.9841 to 27.9834 ms (-3.45%). At DPR 2, throughput improved from 25.5484 to 30.0012 steps/s (+17.43%) and paced p95 improved from 28.0259 to 27.8835 ms (-0.51%).

All six candidate projects preserved the exact Taffy vector `1123,229,341,782,1041,25,673,726,755,780,405,377,0,82,0,0`, nine batches, 12 buffer writes, 10 bind groups, two passes, one submission, 4,440 bounds-tree search visits, 576 retained bounds nodes, 8,668 global path elements, the exact final scroll offset, and zero terminal error.

The vendored Taffy library suite passed 96 tests. Its alloc-only feature check, focused gpux Taffy telemetry test, diagnostics-off/on gpux/WGPU/browser-WASM checks, gpux-owned warning-denied Clippy, package-scoped formatting, dependency-tree proof, vendored-file integrity comparison, AgentX memory audit, and improvement-loop validation passed. The complete published Taffy package predates the active rustfmt and has four existing current-Clippy `wrong_self_convention` findings in unchanged grid style code; those upstream-only findings were not mixed into this atomic optimization.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Accept the two-slot inline Taffy child representation. It removes 726 measured heap allocations per warmed frame, preserves all behavior counters, and improves the central runtime distribution at both DPRs without a paced-p95 regression.

Retain the full package provenance and dedicated gpux update guide. Re-evaluate the patch during every Taffy upgrade and remove it if upstream gains an equivalent representation. Do not increase the capacity without fresh fanout and runtime measurements.
